newsitem.title: USA: NYPA Fitzpatrick nuke to hold 800 MW till year end.
newsitem.headline: NYPA Fitzpatrick nuke to hold 800 MW till year end.

text.p: The New York Power Authority (NYPA) said Tuesday output at its James A Fitzpatrick nuclear power plant will hold at 800 megawatts (MW) at least until year end after an extended refueling and maintenance outage.
"We're actually producing at 100 percent under the old rate," said NYPA spokesman Woody Berzen.
Fitzpatrick's production capacity was upgraded to 832 MW following the latest outage.
The power plant, in Scriba, N.Y., would stay at 96 percent of its new capacity rating while engineers perform various tests, Berzen said.
NYPA produces about a fourth of New York state's electricity.
